# Tablo Style

Tablo Style is an Azerbaijani online wall art and canvas printing website.

## Website

https://tablo-style.vercel.app

## Purpose

The website provides decorative wall art, personalized canvas prints, home decoration inspiration, pricing information, and blog articles related to interior design and gift ideas.

## Main Pages

- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/
- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/qiymetler
- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/bloq.html

## Articles

- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/blog/divar-tablosu-secimi
- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/blog/dogum-gunu-hediyyesi
- https://tablo-style.vercel.app/blog/ev-dekorasiyasi-fikirleri

## Topics

Wall Art
Canvas Prints
Interior Design
Home Decoration
Gift Ideas
Personalized Gifts

## Audience

Customers in Azerbaijan looking for decorative wall art and personalized gifts.
